senses.en: a person who performs magic tricks; a wizard
a person with exceptional skill

ex.en: The magician pulled a rabbit out of an empty hat.
ex.zh: 魔術師從空帽子裡變出一隻兔子。

senses.en: having or showing great authority; commanding
relating to a magistrate

ex.en: Her magisterial history of the war is now a standard textbook.
ex.zh: 她那部權威的戰爭史如今已是標準教科書。

root.note: 大師般的 → 有權威的

senses.en: the office or authority of a magistrate; magistrates as a group
senses.zh: 地方法官職位；（總稱）地方法官

ex.en: He held the magistracy of the town for twenty years.
ex.zh: 他擔任該鎮的地方法官長達二十年。

root.note: 長官的職位 → 地方法官職位

senses.en: generous and forgiving, especially toward a rival or enemy

ex.en: She was magnanimous in victory and praised her opponent's effort.
ex.zh: 她勝而不驕，大方地稱讚對手的努力。

root.note: 心胸寬大的 → 寬宏大量

senses.en: a wealthy and powerful person in business or industry

ex.en: The shipping magnate donated millions to build a new hospital.
ex.zh: 那位航運大亨捐了數百萬元興建新醫院。

mn: 別和 magnet（磁鐵）搞混，不過大亨也像磁鐵一樣吸金。

senses.en: a piece of iron or other material that attracts iron
a person or place that attracts others strongly

ex.en: The new night market has become a magnet for tourists.
ex.zh: 新夜市已成為吸引觀光客的熱點。

parts.m: lodestone 天然磁石（源自希臘地名 Magnesia）

root.note: 產磁石的地方 → 磁鐵

senses.en: to make something magnetic
to attract strongly; to charm

ex.en: You can magnetize a needle by rubbing it with a magnet.
ex.zh: 用磁鐵摩擦一根針就能讓它磁化。

senses.en: the quality of being extremely beautiful or impressive

ex.en: We were stunned by the magnificence of the palace.
ex.zh: 我們被宮殿的富麗堂皇震懾住了。

senses.en: extremely beautiful, impressive, or excellent

ex.en: From the summit we had a magnificent view of the valley.
ex.zh: 從山頂上我們看到壯麗的山谷景色。

root.note: 做得宏大的 → 壯麗的

senses.en: great size or importance
a measure of the strength of an earthquake or brightness of a star

ex.en: Few people understood the magnitude of the problem at first.
ex.zh: 起初很少人了解這個問題有多嚴重。

senses.en: a great king or prince in India

ex.en: The maharaja's palace is now a luxury hotel.
ex.zh: 大君的宮殿如今成了豪華飯店。

senses.en: the state or time of being a young unmarried woman

ex.en: The poem describes her maidenhood in a quiet mountain village.
ex.zh: 這首詩描寫了她在寧靜山村度過的少女時代。

senses.en: to keep something in good condition or at the same level
to state strongly that something is true

ex.en: It is important to maintain a healthy balance between work and rest.
ex.zh: 在工作與休息之間維持健康的平衡很重要。

senses.en: the process of keeping something in good condition
financial support, such as money paid to a former spouse

ex.en: The elevator is closed for maintenance until Friday.
ex.zh: 電梯維修中，停用到星期五。

root.note: 握在手中照顧 → 維護

senses.en: corn; a tall cereal plant with large ears of yellow grain

ex.en: Maize was first grown by farmers in ancient Mexico.
ex.zh: 玉米最早是由古代墨西哥的農民種植。

senses.en: cosmetics used to improve one's appearance
the way something is composed; a person's character

ex.en: The genetic makeup of each person is unique.
ex.zh: 每個人的基因組成都是獨一無二的。

senses.en: a disease or illness
a serious problem in society

ex.en: Loneliness has been called the malady of modern life.
ex.zh: 孤獨被稱為現代生活的通病。

parts.m: have, hold 處於（拉丁文 male habitus）

root.note: 處於不好的狀態 → 疾病

senses.en: a serious disease spread by mosquitoes, causing fever and chills

ex.en: Bed nets help protect children from malaria.
ex.zh: 蚊帳可以幫助保護孩子免於瘧疾。

root.note: 古人以為瘧疾是沼澤的「壞空氣」造成的

senses.en: a person who is dissatisfied and complains or rebels
senses.zh: 不滿分子；牢騷滿腹的人

senses.en: dissatisfied and complaining

ex.en: Every office seems to have one malcontent who complains about everything.
ex.zh: 每間辦公室似乎都有一個對什麼都抱怨的人。

senses.en: a curse; a statement wishing harm on someone

ex.en: The old witch muttered a malediction as the knights rode away.
ex.zh: 騎士們騎馬離去時，老巫婆喃喃念著詛咒。

senses.en: a person who commits a crime or does wrong

ex.en: The sheriff promised to bring every malefactor to justice.
ex.zh: 警長承諾要將每個作惡者繩之以法。

senses.en: causing harm or evil

ex.en: The story's maleficent fairy placed a curse on the baby princess.
ex.zh: 故事中邪惡的仙女對小公主下了詛咒。

senses.en: the wish to do harm to others

ex.en: There was pure malevolence in the villain's smile.
ex.zh: 反派的笑容裡充滿了惡意。

root.note: 懷著壞的意願 → 惡意

senses.en: to speak about someone in a harmful and untrue way
evil or harmful in nature

ex.en: The politician tried to malign his rival with false rumors.
ex.zh: 那位政治人物試圖用不實謠言中傷對手。

root.note: 天生壞的 → 有害的；說壞話 → 中傷

senses.en: (of a tumor) cancerous and likely to spread
evil and wanting to cause harm

ex.en: Tests showed that the tumor was malignant.
ex.zh: 檢查顯示這個腫瘤是惡性的。

root.note: 天生就壞的 → 惡性的

senses.en: (of metal) able to be hammered or pressed into shape
easily influenced or changed

ex.en: Young children's minds are highly malleable.
ex.zh: 幼童的心智可塑性很高。

root.note: 可以用槌子敲打成形的 → 可塑的

senses.en: a hammer with a large wooden or rubber head

ex.en: He used a rubber mallet to tap the tiles into place.
ex.zh: 他用橡膠槌把磁磚敲到定位。

senses.en: to treat a person or animal cruelly or violently

ex.en: Anyone who is found to maltreat animals will face a heavy fine.
ex.zh: 任何被查到虐待動物的人都將面臨重罰。

senses.en: an animal, such as a tiger or shark, that eats people
(informal) a woman who has many lovers

ex.en: Villagers feared that a man-eater was hiding in the jungle.
ex.zh: 村民擔心有吃人的猛獸躲在叢林裡。

senses.en: a trap for catching trespassers; any dangerous place or situation

ex.en: The old estate was guarded by a hidden man-trap in the woods.
ex.zh: 這座老莊園在樹林裡藏有捕人陷阱來防範闖入者。

senses.en: an official order or authority given to someone
to officially require something

ex.en: The winning party claimed a clear mandate to reform health care.
ex.zh: 勝選的政黨宣稱獲得了改革健保的明確民意授權。

root.note: 交到手上（的任務）→ 授權；命令

senses.en: required by law or rules; compulsory

ex.en: Wearing a helmet is mandatory for all scooter riders in Taiwan.
ex.zh: 在台灣，所有騎機車的人都必須戴安全帽。

root.note: 交付的命令 → 強制的

senses.en: long hair on the neck of a horse or lion
a person's long, thick hair

ex.en: The lion shook its thick golden mane.
ex.zh: 獅子甩動牠濃密的金色鬃毛。

senses.en: a movement requiring skill and care
a clever plan to gain an advantage; (pl.) military exercises
senses.zh: 策略；花招；（複數）軍事演習

senses.en: to move or guide skillfully

ex.en: She had to maneuver the car carefully into the tiny parking space.
ex.zh: 她得小心地把車開進那個狹小的停車位。

senses.en: an extreme enthusiasm or craze
a mental state of extreme excitement and overactivity

ex.en: Beatle mania swept across America in 1964.
ex.zh: 1964 年，披頭四熱潮席捲美國。

senses.en: a person who behaves wildly or dangerously
a person with an extreme enthusiasm for something

ex.en: Some maniac was driving at twice the speed limit.
ex.zh: 有個瘋子以速限的兩倍在開車。

senses.en: a public declaration of the aims and policies of a group

ex.en: The party published a manifesto promising cheaper housing.
ex.zh: 該黨發表了一份承諾降低房價的政見。

root.note: 清楚擺在眼前的聲明 → 宣言

senses.en: resembling a human being; having qualities typical of a man

ex.en: The fossil shows a manlike creature that walked on two legs.
ex.zh: 這塊化石顯示一種用雙腳行走、類似人類的生物。

senses.en: the qualities traditionally expected of a man, such as courage and strength

ex.en: The film questions old ideas about manliness and toughness.
ex.zh: 這部電影質疑了關於男子氣概和堅強的舊觀念。

senses.en: a habitual gesture or way of speaking
excessive use of a particular style in art or writing
senses.zh: （藝術、寫作的）矯揉造作；風格主義

ex.en: The actor copied every mannerism of the president perfectly.
ex.zh: 那名演員完美模仿了總統的每個習慣動作。

root.note: 特有的方式 → 習慣動作

senses.en: a large country house with lands; (historical) a feudal estate

ex.en: The old manor has been turned into a museum.
ex.zh: 那座古老的莊園已經改建成博物館。

parts.m: stay, remain 停留（拉丁文 manere）

senses.en: a shelf above a fireplace

ex.en: Family photos lined the mantel above the fireplace.
ex.zh: 壁爐上方的架子擺滿了全家福照片。

mn: mantel（壁爐架）與 mantle（斗篷；責任）同音。

senses.en: an important role or responsibility passed from one person to another
a loose sleeveless cloak; a covering layer
the layer of the earth between the crust and the core

ex.en: After her mother retired, she took on the mantle of family leader.
ex.zh: 母親退休後，她接下了一家之主的重任。

mn: 片語 take on the mantle：接下衣缽、承擔重任。

senses.en: a person or company that makes goods in large quantities

ex.en: The manufacturer recalled thousands of faulty phones.
ex.zh: 這家製造商召回了數千支有瑕疵的手機。

root.note: 原指用手做東西的人 → 製造商

senses.en: the act of freeing a slave

ex.en: Some slaves bought their own manumission after years of saving.
ex.zh: 有些奴隸存了多年的錢，為自己贖得了自由。

root.note: 從（主人）手中放走 → 解放奴隸

senses.en: to release from slavery

ex.en: In his will, the landowner chose to manumit all of his slaves.
ex.zh: 那位地主在遺囑中決定解放他所有的奴隸。

root.note: 從手中放走 → 解放奴隸

senses.en: relating to the sea
a member of a navy's infantry force

ex.en: Plastic waste is a serious threat to marine life.
ex.zh: 塑膠垃圾對海洋生物是嚴重的威脅。

senses.en: relating to the sea, especially shipping and trade
living or found near the sea

ex.en: The city's maritime museum displays models of old sailing ships.
ex.zh: 這座城市的海事博物館展出古代帆船模型。

senses.en: to leave someone trapped and alone in an isolated place
senses.zh: 將（人）遺棄在荒島；使受困

senses.en: a dark brownish-red color

ex.en: The pirates decided to maroon the traitor on a deserted island.
ex.zh: 海盜們決定把叛徒丟棄在荒島上。

senses.en: relating to war or the military

ex.en: The government declared martial law after the coup.
ex.zh: 政變後政府宣布戒嚴。

mn: martial arts 武術；martial law 戒嚴。

senses.en: relating to the planet Mars
an imagined inhabitant of Mars

ex.en: The rover collected samples of Martian soil.
ex.zh: 探測車採集了火星土壤的樣本。

senses.en: the death or suffering of a martyr
a display of suffering to gain sympathy

ex.en: The saint's martyrdom is remembered every year with a festival.
ex.zh: 每年都有節慶紀念這位聖人的殉道。

senses.en: to be filled with wonder or surprise
a wonderful or astonishing person or thing
senses.zh: 奇蹟；令人驚嘆的人事物

ex.en: Visitors always marvel at the size of the ancient temple.
ex.zh: 遊客們總是對這座古廟的規模讚嘆不已。

senses.en: stonework or brickwork; the craft of a mason
senses.zh: 石造建築；磚石工程；石工手藝

ex.en: Loose masonry fell from the old building during the earthquake.
ex.zh: 地震時，老建築上鬆動的磚石掉了下來。

root.note: 石匠的作品 → 石造建築

senses.en: a false show or pretense
a party where people wear masks and costumes
to pretend to be someone or something else

ex.en: His friendliness was only a masquerade to hide his true intentions.
ex.zh: 他的友善只是為了掩飾真正意圖的偽裝。

root.note: 戴面具的活動 → 化裝舞會；偽裝

senses.en: the brutal killing of many people
to kill many people cruelly; (informal) to defeat heavily

ex.en: The village memorial honors the victims of the massacre.
ex.zh: 村裡的紀念碑悼念大屠殺的受害者。

senses.en: very large, heavy, and solid
exceptionally large in amount or degree

ex.en: The storm caused massive damage along the coast.
ex.zh: 這場暴風雨對沿海地區造成了巨大的破壞。

senses.en: a work of outstanding skill; a person's best work

ex.en: Many critics consider the novel a masterpiece of modern literature.
ex.zh: 許多評論家認為這部小說是現代文學的傑作。

senses.en: great skill or knowledge in a subject
control or power over something

ex.en: She showed complete mastery of the piano at a young age.
ex.zh: 她年紀輕輕就展現了對鋼琴的精湛掌握。

senses.en: the substance from which something is made
relating to physical things rather than the mind
important and relevant

ex.en: Bamboo is a strong and sustainable building material.
ex.zh: 竹子是一種堅固且永續的建材。

root.note: 萬物之母 → 物質、材料

senses.en: to become real or actually happen
to appear suddenly

ex.en: The promised pay raise did not materialize.
ex.zh: 說好的加薪並沒有實現。

root.note: 變成實體 → 實現；出現

senses.en: relating to a mother; motherly
related through the mother's side of the family

ex.en: My maternal grandparents live in Tainan.
ex.zh: 我的外公外婆住在台南。

senses.en: an afternoon performance of a play or showing of a film

ex.en: Tickets for the Saturday matinee are cheaper than evening shows.
ex.zh: 週六午場的票比晚場便宜。

root.note: 原指上午的活動 → 日場

senses.en: the killing of one's mother; a person who does this

ex.en: The Greek tragedy tells of a son who commits matricide to avenge his father.
ex.zh: 這部希臘悲劇講述一個兒子為父報仇而弒母的故事。

senses.en: the state of being married; marriage

ex.en: The couple were joined in holy matrimony last spring.
ex.zh: 這對佳偶去年春天結為連理。

root.note: 成為母親的狀態 → 婚姻

senses.en: an environment in which something develops
(mathematics) a rectangular array of numbers
a mold in which something is shaped

ex.en: Solve the equation by multiplying the matrix by the vector.
ex.zh: 把矩陣乘上向量來解這個方程式。

root.note: 孕育東西的母體 → 環境；鑄模

senses.en: unemotional and practical
senses.zh: 就事論事的；不帶感情的；實事求是的

ex.en: The doctor delivered the bad news in a calm, matter-of-fact tone.
ex.zh: 醫生以平靜、就事論事的語氣宣布了壞消息。

senses.en: self-pityingly or tearfully sentimental
senses.zh: 多愁善感的；（尤指醉後）自憐落淚的

ex.en: The movie's maudlin ending made some viewers roll their eyes.
ex.zh: 這部電影濫情的結局讓一些觀眾翻白眼。

root.note: 畫中常見哭泣的抹大拉的馬利亞 → 哭哭啼啼的

senses.en: a large, grand tomb

ex.en: The emperor's mausoleum was guarded by thousands of clay soldiers.
ex.zh: 皇帝的陵墓由數千個陶俑士兵守衛。

parts.m: Mausolus 摩索拉斯（古代國王）

root.note: 源自摩索拉斯王的巨大陵墓

senses.en: sentimental in an exaggerated or false way
senses.zh: 過於傷感的；肉麻的；濫情的

ex.en: The greeting card was full of mawkish verses about friendship.
ex.zh: 這張卡片寫滿了關於友誼的肉麻詩句。

senses.en: a short statement of a general truth or rule of conduct

ex.en: "Measure twice, cut once" is a maxim every carpenter knows.
ex.zh: 「量兩次，切一次」是每個木匠都知道的格言。

root.note: 最重要的道理 → 格言

senses.en: a complex network of paths designed as a puzzle
a confusing mass of information or things

ex.en: The children got lost in the hedge maze for almost an hour.
ex.zh: 孩子們在樹籬迷宮裡迷路了將近一小時。

senses.en: an alcoholic drink made from fermented honey and water
(literary) a meadow

ex.en: The Vikings drank mead from horns at their feasts.
ex.zh: 維京人在宴會上用牛角杯喝蜂蜜酒。

senses.en: lacking in quantity or quality; very small

ex.en: He could barely feed his family on his meager salary.
ex.zh: 他微薄的薪水幾乎養不活一家人。

senses.en: afraid to speak plainly or honestly
senses.zh: 說話拐彎抹角的；不敢直言的

ex.en: Voters were tired of mealy-mouthed answers from the candidates.
ex.zh: 選民受夠了候選人拐彎抹角的回答。

senses.en: to follow a winding course
to wander slowly and aimlessly

ex.en: We watched the river meander through the green valley.
ex.zh: 我們看著河流蜿蜒穿過翠綠的山谷。

parts.m: Maeander 米安德河（今土耳其）

root.note: 源自一條以彎曲出名的河流 → 蜿蜒

senses.en: the branch of physics dealing with motion and forces
the practical details or workings of something

ex.en: Students learn the basic laws of mechanics in first-year physics.
ex.zh: 學生在一年級物理課學習力學的基本定律。

senses.en: a large medal, often worn on a chain
a round decorative design

ex.en: The mayor wore a gold medallion on a chain around her neck.
ex.zh: 市長脖子上戴著一條掛著金色圓牌的鏈子。

senses.en: fond of interfering in other people's business

ex.en: Our meddlesome neighbor always asks who is visiting us.
ex.zh: 我們那個愛管閒事的鄰居總是問誰來我們家。

senses.en: located in the middle; toward the middle of the body

ex.en: The injury was on the medial side of his left knee.
ex.zh: 受傷的部位在他左膝的內側。

senses.en: to try to settle a dispute between two sides
to bring about or influence a result

ex.en: A neutral country offered to mediate between the two sides.
ex.zh: 一個中立國表示願意在雙方之間進行調停。

senses.en: a substance taken to treat or prevent illness
the science or practice of treating illness

ex.en: Take this medicine twice a day after meals.
ex.zh: 這個藥一天吃兩次，飯後服用。

root.note: 醫生的技藝 → 醫學；藥

senses.en: relating to the Middle Ages (about 500–1500 AD)
(informal) very old-fashioned or primitive

ex.en: The medieval castle still stands on the hill above the town.
ex.zh: 那座中世紀城堡仍矗立在小鎮上方的山丘上。

root.note: 中間的時代 → 中世紀的

senses.en: of only average or poor quality

ex.en: The food was mediocre, but the view from the restaurant was amazing.
ex.zh: 餐點普普通通，但餐廳的景觀很棒。

parts.m: mountain peak 山峰（拉丁文 ocris）

root.note: 只到半山腰 → 平庸的

senses.en: the practice of focusing the mind for relaxation or spiritual purposes
serious, careful thought; a written reflection

ex.en: Ten minutes of meditation each morning helps me stay calm.
ex.zh: 每天早上冥想十分鐘能幫助我保持冷靜。

root.note: 深入思考 → 沉思；冥想

senses.en: a mixture of different things
a series of songs performed as one piece; a swimming race using several strokes

ex.en: The band played a medley of hits from the 1980s.
ex.zh: 樂團演奏了一組 1980 年代的熱門歌曲組曲。

senses.en: to make or become better; to improve

ex.en: Reformers hoped to meliorate the living conditions of factory workers.
ex.zh: 改革者希望改善工廠工人的生活條件。

senses.en: (of a voice or words) sweet and smooth; pleasant to hear

ex.en: The radio host had a deep, mellifluous voice.
ex.zh: 那位電台主持人有著低沉悅耳的嗓音。

root.note: 像蜂蜜般流動的 → 甜美流暢

senses.en: pleasant-sounding; tuneful

ex.en: We woke to the melodious song of birds outside the window.
ex.zh: 我們在窗外悅耳的鳥鳴聲中醒來。

senses.en: a play or film with exaggerated characters and emotions
behavior that is overly dramatic

ex.en: Stop the melodrama; it's just a small scratch.
ex.zh: 別這麼誇張了，只是個小擦傷而已。

root.note: 原指配樂的戲劇 → 情節誇張的通俗劇

senses.en: an object kept as a reminder of a person or event

ex.en: She kept the ticket stub as a memento of their first date.
ex.zh: 她留著票根作為兩人第一次約會的紀念。

parts.m: remember! 記住（拉丁文命令式）

senses.en: worth remembering or easily remembered

ex.en: Our trip to the mountains was truly memorable.
ex.zh: 我們的山區之旅真是令人難忘。

senses.en: a person or thing that is likely to cause harm; a threat
to threaten

ex.en: Drunk drivers are a menace to everyone on the road.
ex.zh: 酒駕者對路上每個人都是威脅。

parts.m: project, threaten 突出、威脅（拉丁文 minae）

senses.en: a collection of wild animals kept for display
a strange or varied group of people or things
senses.zh: 形形色色的一群人或物

ex.en: Her apartment houses a menagerie of cats, birds, and turtles.
ex.zh: 她的公寓裡養了貓、鳥和烏龜等一大群動物。

senses.en: not telling the truth; lying

ex.en: The report exposed the company's mendacious advertising claims.
ex.zh: 這份報告揭露了該公司不實的廣告說詞。

parts.m: fault, lie 缺陷、謊言（拉丁文 mendax）

mn: 和 mendicant（乞丐）拼法相近，別搞混。

senses.en: a beggar; a member of a religious order living on charity
living by begging

ex.en: A mendicant monk walked from village to village asking for food.
ex.zh: 一位托缽僧從一個村莊走到另一個村莊化緣。

senses.en: a characteristic way of thinking of a person or group

ex.en: The coach tried to build a winning mentality in the team.
ex.zh: 教練努力在隊中建立求勝的心態。

senses.en: an experienced and trusted adviser
to advise or train someone less experienced

ex.en: My high school mentor encouraged me to apply for the scholarship.
ex.zh: 我的高中導師鼓勵我申請這份獎學金。

mn: 源自荷馬史詩中奧德修斯之子的良師 Mentor。

senses.en: relating to trade or merchants

ex.en: Venice grew rich as a mercantile power in the Middle Ages.
ex.zh: 威尼斯在中世紀作為一個商業強權而致富。

senses.en: a soldier hired to fight for a foreign army
motivated mainly by money

ex.en: It seemed mercenary of him to marry for money.
ex.zh: 他為了錢而結婚，似乎太唯利是圖了。
